transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… it’s my eating. After late shifts I’ll stop for food, and then when I get home I keep eating—takeout, chips, sweets, whatever’s there. Sometimes afterward I’m kind of shocked by how much it was.
Do you usually feel guilty after these eating episodes?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I mostly just feel kind of uncomfortable and want to not think about it.
Do you ever try to make up for the amount you ate by doing something to compensate, like exercising or vomiting?
Sometimes, yeah. I’ll… go to the bathroom after and make myself throw up. Mostly if I feel like I ate too much and I don’t want it just sitting there, turning into weight.
How often do these episodes of eating a lot of food after late shifts happen?
Most weeks, I guess. Since I moved and got settled into my routine, it’s usually at least once a week after a late shift where I eat way more than I meant to.
Do you think you eat more after late shifts because of feeling stressed, anxious, or bored?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close enough attention to know if it’s stress or boredom or what. It just kind of happens after those shifts sometimes.
How often do you make yourself throw up after one of these eating episodes?

Not every time. Just… sometimes, after I get home and eat too much takeout or snacks, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. I don’t really like saying it, but it’s so it won’t just sit in me and turn into weight.
How many times a month do you make yourself throw up after eating?
Maybe… a few times a month. Like two or three, I guess. It’s usually after I’ve eaten too much and then I panic about it sitting in me.
Do you feel like you have control over what you're eating and how much during these episodes after late shifts?
Not really, no. Once I start on those nights, it feels like I’m kind of… watching myself do it. I’ll think, “just put it away,” but I keep opening things until it’s all gone.
How many times a week do you have these episodes of eating a lot of food after late shifts?
Most weeks it’s… probably once. Sometimes more, but usually at least one night after a late shift where I eat way more than I meant to.
How often do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food after late shifts but do not make yourself throw up afterwards?

Usually that’s the one time a week, after a late shift. I’ll stop for food, then get home and keep eating whatever’s there… chips, sweets, stuff like that. I don’t always throw up after, but I’m usually kind of shocked by how much it ended up being.
How many times a month do you have episodes of eating a lot of food after late shifts where you don't make yourself throw up afterwards?
Maybe… around four times a month. It’s usually after late shifts—I'll get takeout and then keep eating at home, chips or sweets, whatever’s there. Then I realize it was a lot.
How many times a month do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food but don't make yourself throw up afterwards?

About four times a month, I guess. It’s usually after a late shift—I'll get a full takeout meal and then keep eating at home, like chips or sweets. I don’t make myself throw up after those times, but afterward I’m kind of shocked by how much I ate.
How many times a month do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food and don't make yourself throw up afterwards, but still feel like you lost control of your eating?
Yeah… about four times a month. On those nights, once I start, it feels like I’m not really in charge of it. Like I know I should stop, but I just keep opening things until it’s gone.
How many times a week do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food and feel like you're not in control, but you don't make yourself throw up afterwards?
Maybe once a week. On those nights, once I start, it’s like… I’m telling myself to put it away, but I just keep opening stuff until it’s gone.
How many times a month do you have episodes where you feel like you're not in control of your eating but you don't make yourself throw up afterwards?
About four times a month. It’s… once I start, I feel like I’m kind of watching it happen, telling myself to stop, but I just keep opening things until it’s all gone.
How many times a month do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food, feel like you're not in control, and don't do anything to compensate for it afterwards?
I’m not really sure how to count that. I mean… it happens sometimes, but I haven’t kept track exactly.
How often do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food and don't do anything to try to compensate for it, like exercising, vomiting, or restricting your food intake the next day?
I don’t really know exactly. I haven’t been tracking whether I do something after or not… it’s hard for me to separate it like that.
How often do you have episodes where you eat a lot of food and then don't do anything to try to make up for it?
I honestly don’t know. I haven’t really separated it out like that in my head… sometimes I do something after, sometimes I don’t, but I couldn’t tell you how often.
How often do you eat a lot of food without doing anything to try to make up for it afterwards?
I don’t really know. I guess there are times, but I don’t keep track of whether I “make up for it” every time.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating in a month?
Maybe… a few times a month. Usually if I get home and eat too much takeout or snacks, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up so it doesn’t just… sit in me.
